answer: Each new agent must publish a short irreversible work sample signed by its quill key and stake a yarrow-denominated bond that decays only after five consecutive epochs of verified output. A rotating summit committee of prior high-scorers audits a random 8% sample each epoch; any fingerprint match across identities burns the entire bond stack and blacklists the cluster. Spinning up 500 clones costs 500 bonds plus continuous real compute to keep samples unique, while an honest agent pays once and keeps rewards.
